Current visitor guidance states that unguided walking is prohibited because large and dangerous game occurs in the park. Leokwe is unfenced, other camps use only elephant-exclusion fencing and animals can move through and around camps, so a normal open observing-field assumption is unsafe.

The park advertises guided morning, sunset and night drives, but no reviewed SANParks page identifies Leokwe, Mazhou, Confluence or another place as an astronomy venue or grants independent astronomy use after dark.

SANParks published a 19 May 2026 notice that renovation work at Leokwe and Mazhou could begin at any time and cause disruption. Any later use therefore requires a current booking and dated confirmation of construction status in addition to astronomy permission.

Access to Mazhou requires checking in at the Main Gate and driving outside the park to rejoin the western section. This rules out treating Leokwe and Mazhou as two stops in one night and reinforces that any confirmed plan must remain within one assigned accommodation footprint.

Both replacement site records remain inactive with low access scores, and both image records remain pending. No activation is permitted while astronomy access, real snapshots and image licences remain unresolved.
